title: First player's greedy choice
statement: Given a natural number $n$, a Boolean-valued winning condition $W$ on finite Boolean histories, and a history $h$, the first player's greedy choice is the value of the recursive position evaluation at the history obtained by appending true to $h$, with $\max(n-(|h|+1),0)$ steps remaining.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean-valued winning condition on finite Boolean histories
